findings.evidence: Fixed explicit list of16 administrative metadata/code/protocol/review inputs. Parses only payload STATE, B remote REVIEW and BUILD_COMPLETE. Bytecopies other listed administrative records without interpreting scientific/data/image content.

findings.item: Fresh exclusive writes and immutable history
findings.evidence: new_file checks every parent with lstat/S_ISDIR, uses xb for each destination, rejects forbidden names. Destinations are fresh V187 closing files/receipt/note, new ADMIN closing plan and top-level V187 publication receipt; no frozen V187 source-phase or old manifest-covered destination is written. Input read traverses every component with NOFOLLOW and requires ordinary file.

findings.item: Completed payload and independent public remote barrier
findings.evidence: Requires completed_all, pending=None and expected_remote30478a5ce93243fe297aeecb6337bba2b4276098; B completed/PASS/public/default_branch main, expected/before/after commit all equal payload, selected_files_verified5, remote raw/blob/base64/pixel reads0. Receipt verified_payload_commit is the already pushed payload. Closing bytes and their SHA/size are sealed by a later separate push plan; no claimed own closing commit SHA.

Plan supplies authorized_main_push, repository, remote, branch, initial_remote_main, batch_max_bytes, batches[files{path,size_bytes,sha256},message]. findings.item: No Git execution or research mutation
findings.evidence: Helper imports only pathlib/datetime/hashlib/json/os/stat, has no subprocess or Git command calls. It prepares a closing-only plan for later authorized strict push; source/model/query/labels untouched.

Three ../../../ links resolve from publication/deltas/V187_20261024_v1/ to the existing publication-root index/report/catalog. Same-delta receipt/verification/closing links resolve without escape; no absolute home/file links in the static note.

limits: This is code-only static review, not helper execution, actual-copy/file-existence verification or remote recheck.
No payload/remote metadata bodies, source/evaluation arrays, images, models or weights were opened by this review; the root and B actual receipts remain the numerical/publication evidence.
Hardcoded published counts and payload commit match the root-provided closed summary; this review does not independently recalculate those counts.
The strict runner must be executed separately with this closing plan and a fresh state; no Git mutation or push was performed here.
